Bundled third-party libraries (unmodified, from npm), used only inside the sandboxed preview page:

- marked 12.0.2 (MIT) - Markdown to HTML
- dompurify 3.1.6 (Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0) - sanitizes the Markdown output
- mermaid 10.9.1 (MIT) - Mermaid diagrams, loaded only when a Mermaid block is previewed
